metaDescription: puppy vaccine schedule: timing table, what to do if a dose is late, and reminders before boosters are due.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters
paragraphs: This puppy plan sequences doses against parvovirus exposure risk, not against a vague “sometime this season” intention for your dog.

Milestone labels on the puppy table (8 weeks; 12 weeks; 16 weeks; 16 weeks) are operational deadlines for daycare, boarding, travel, and multi-pet intros — a nearly finished puppy puppy series is still incomplete.

If your household also wrestles with incomplete series before daycare or lost shot records at rehoming, put those constraints on the same calendar thread as the DA2PP / DHPP booster so one reminder system owns the puppy week.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Call the clinic with product names and prior dates the day you notice a missed puppy dose; catch-up timing depends on age and gap length for this dog scenario.
Until the puppy series is current again, reduce the exposure pattern that matches parvovirus exposure risk, and do not wait for an annual wellness slot to ask about a puppy make-up dose.
After the visit, enable 7-, 3-, and 1-day nudges for the next DA2PP / DHPP booster due date so the same puppy miss cannot hide inside a shared family calendar.

faqs.question: Is this puppy vaccine schedule a prescription?
faqs.answer: No. It is an editorial planning table aligned with common AAHA/AAFP-style windows and facility patterns. Your veterinarian sets the legal and medical plan for the individual dog.

faqs.question: What if we already missed a date on this puppy schedule?
faqs.answer: Contact the clinic for catch-up timing. Bring prior records, limit high-risk exposure tied to parvovirus exposure risk, and reset reminders as soon as the next puppy due date is known.

faqs.question: How do reminders help with DA2PP / DHPP booster?
faqs.answer: PetClues can nudge you 7, 3, and 1 day before that puppy booster is due so boarding and travel deadlines stop arriving as surprises.
